description: Structured, agent-aware logging for .NET on a Rust core: the same record shape, redaction and tamper-evident hash chain as the other LogQuill bindings.
Entity Framework Core integration for tenant isolation: composite tenant keys, enforced query filters, save-time ownership enforcement and tenant-aware repositories.
(De)serialize the string table of Red Alert 2 from/to .ini files, on top of SadPencil.Ra2CsfFile.
Redis response caching for Weir with binary payload leases and atomic invalidation fencing.
Search game listings on several public game sites and get the title, link and image of each result.

An EF Core model composed from the FusionModules modules a host loads: UseModules on the context's options, ApplyModuleConfigurations in OnModelCreating. Every module's entity configurations, each module after the modules it references, and one cached model per set of modules.

Integration tests for a FusionModules host, one topology at a time: a WebApplicationFactory that boots the host with the modules a test names, exactly as HOSTINGSTARTUPASSEMBLIES does in a deployment; settings that keep a topology test off the database and away from the modules' workers; and the ho…
Dependency-light contracts for registering, resolving, authorizing and invoking HoneyDrunk Grid capabilities (agent-callable tools).
Test fixtures for HoneyDrunk Grid capabilities: a harness over the real registry and invoker, a scripted guard, a recording handler and descriptor fixtures. For test projects only.
Contracts for HoneyDrunk agent memory: scope keys, entries, the scoped store, scope resolution and summarization.
In-memory HoneyDrunk agent-memory store for tests and local development. Not for production composition.

Ads pages for Webority admin portals: campaign figures by platform, conversions and leads, audiences, campaign builds, the optimiser's proposals and changes, and ad copy, in Webority.Ui.Razor markup under an Ads area the product secures with one policy.

SQL Server sink for AuditLoggingPipeline.Telemetry. Writes usage events in batches through a stored procedure and a table-valued parameter. The consuming app owns the tables; the connection and procedure names are options.

Modern, responsive, zero-dependency alert dialogs and toast notifications for Windows Forms inspired by SweetAlert2. Supports modals, toasts, inputs, animations, and timer auto-close in both sync and async APIs.
